intro: A spouse visa extension gives you another 2 years 6 months in the UK on the route to settlement. You must meet the requirements again, including A2 English, so we check everything has stayed on track.

rules.title: Apply before your visa expires
rules.text: Applying late can break your continuous residence. We advise on the best time to apply.

rules.title: Which financial threshold?
rules.text: If you were first granted before April 2024, a lower threshold may still apply to you. We check which applies.

rules.title: Route to settlement
rules.text: Partners of British citizens keep a 5-year route to Indefinite Leave to Remain under the government’s plans. [Read about the ILR changes](/ilr-changes-2026/)

boxTitle: Want a second pair of eyes before you apply?
boxText: A consultation costs far less than a refused application. We’ll check your case against the current rules and tell you honestly where you stand.

sections.heading: Spouse visa extension requirements
sections.text: You must still be in a genuine relationship and living together, meet the financial requirement at the level that applies to you, pass English at A2 level unless exempt, and have adequate accommodation.

sections.heading: After your spouse visa extension
sections.text: When you complete your qualifying period, you can apply for [Indefinite Leave to Remain](/indefinite-leave-to-remain/). Check your [time outside the UK](/absence-calculator/) as you go.

faqs.q: When should I apply for my spouse visa extension?
faqs.a: Before your current visa expires. We help you choose the best date.

faqs.q: Do I need a new English test for my spouse visa extension?
faqs.a: Yes, at A2 level, unless you’re exempt or already passed at a higher level.

faqs.q: Does the £29,000 threshold apply to my extension?
faqs.a: It depends when you were first granted. Some people keep the earlier threshold.
